inputs.goal: hire a senior backend engineer who can own our payments service

define-role.intake.summary: Need to identify and hire a senior backend engineer with specific expertise in payments systems, API development, and financial service architecture to lead our payments service initiative.

define-role.generate.draft:
Senior Backend Engineer - Payments Service Lead

Requirements:
- 5+ years backend development experience
- Specialized in payments systems and financial services
- Strong API design and microservices architecture skills
- Experience with payment gateways (Stripe, PayPal, etc.)
- Knowledge of security compliance (PCI DSS, SOX)
- Proven track record owning end-to-end service development

Key Responsibilities:
- Lead payments service architecture and implementation
- Design secure, scalable payment processing systems
- Collaborate with security, compliance, and frontend teams
- Mentor junior engineers and maintain code quality standards
- Own service performance, reliability, and scalability

Preferred Experience:
- Previous role as tech lead or engineering manager
- Background in fintech or e-commerce platforms
- Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure)
- Understanding of fraud detection and risk management systems
